name: rainier
description: Rainier: a shared m0saic template repo for artists. Layouts lifted from real short-form posts, rebuilt as templates you fill with your own clips, song and lyrics.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node tools/copy-assets.mjs && node dist/gen-template-manifest.js && node tools/check-registry.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run lint && npm test && npm run test:contract && npm run check:deps

//dependencies: The @m0saic/* substrate is on npm. AUTHOR MODE (build / test / lint) is
`npm install && npm run verify` — no monorepo checkout, no file: links.
dist/ and template-manifest.json ARE committed: Mosaic Desktop loads this
repo straight from GitHub (Templates -> Add source -> the repo URL) and
hosts only ever import dist/index.js. Rebuild before every commit.
